_comment: Ratio ceilings for tests/bench/gate.py. Each key is <case>/<plaintext bytes> and each
value is the most that case may cost relative to the bare-OpenSSL reference measured in
the same process (tests/bench/bench_support.h explains the reference).
max_ratio is null on purpose: recording only, not gating. The numbers depend on the CPU's
AES and SHA instructions, so a ceiling taken from a developer machine would be wrong on a
CI runner in whichever direction happened to be convenient. Fill this from three runs of
the bench workflow on the reference runner, the way tests/load/baseline.json was filled,
and record the measurements in docs/perf.md in the same change.
A missing ceiling for a case that exists is a violation, not a pass — otherwise a new
benchmark would be added and silently ungated.
